hanjatooltip-desc: Tags Han ideographs and shows a dictionary tooltip on click or tap.
apihelp-hanja-summary: Look up one Han character in the external hanja dictionary.
apihelp-hanja-param-char: The single character to look up.
apierror-hanjatooltip-notonechar: The char parameter must be exactly one character.
apierror-hanjatooltip-config: The hanja dictionary database is not configured.
